findings.text: follow-on: the grouped row's assertion compares event["fleet_verdict"]["recovery"] against event["recovery"] only, which the pre-change hand-built verdict also satisfied, so it does not guard the new routing of grouped reports through _watch_verdict that this change introduces; asserting event["fleet_verdict"]["state"] == "lane-event" would bind the group-to-emitter wiring.

follow-on: the display alias "lane event" is added into STATE_HUE, which the module also unions into CLASSIFIER_STATE_WORDS (the frozenset documented as the producer/classifier vocabulary), so that set now carries a display form with a space; the exhaustive binding at tests/test_ticker_row_is_one_transition.py:82 compares two STATE_HUE-derived sets and so cannot catch a display/classifier divergence. A separate display-alias table, or a hue lookup that falls back through DISPLAY, keeps the classifier vocabulary clean.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the two commits bbf96cca..63600e23: 26990870 replaces the hand-built grouped fleet_verdict in group_terminal_lane_events with a call to _watch_verdict, adds a lane_event early-return branch to _watch_verdict, and adds the display alias "lane event" to both STATE_HUE themes; 63600e23 records the fragment evidence only, and is source-identical to head.
item_verdicts.done_when: The merged-head contract check requires the palette to cover every displayed state word and every NEEDS_ACTION state to be emitted by the verdict reducer. tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py::test_every_state_the_snapshot_can_emit_has_a_colour and tests/test_fleet_counter_coverage.py::test_the_blocked_bucket_is_derived_from_the_attention_set both refused at bbf96cca (('light', ['lane event']) and lane-event absent from the emitted set) and both pass at head; independently re-run here at 63600e23, 6 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: The two commits close the two merged-head contract gaps that a continuation found: give the displayed word 'lane event' a hue in both themes, and derive grouped fleet verdicts through the shared _watch_verdict emitter. reckon/crew/recovery.py group_terminal_lane_events now calls _watch_verdict (line 7255), which gained a lane_event early-return branch (line 9099) emitting state/recovery_classification 'lane-event'; reckon/crew/ticker.py STATE_HUE gained the display alias "lane event" (124 light / 203 dark) beside the internal "lane-event" key.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete; the six-file base arm (7fbe5fd8, 16 failed/379 passed) and head arm (26990870, 5 failed/390 passed) are recorded as JSON with literal absolute-path commands, completed true and log paths; added_failure_ids is empty over the run's own gate logs; the negative-control log names the zero-window mutation.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The two commits bbf96cca..63600e23 touch exactly reckon/crew/recovery.py, reckon/crew/ticker.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/simultaneous-ends-are-one-lane-event.html, all inside the manifest's declared write paths; no file outside scope is modified and no plan or shared index is touched.

justifications.durability: The fix is guarded by exhaustive property tests with demonstrated teeth: two independent mutations (drop the hue alias; retarget the emitted state word) each redden exactly the corresponding test, and the run's reproduction log shows the same two tests red at bbf96cca. Docked because neither commit adds a test, and no arm asserts that group_terminal_lane_events' own output fleet_verdict carries state 'lane-event', so a future regression of the group-to-emitter wiring would not redden a recorded test.
justifications.evidence: Both arms are recorded at their own revision with literal absolute-path commands and completed true, and the run's own merged-gaps reproduction log shows the two targeted tests red at bbf96cca and green after the fix; the negative-control log names its zero-window mutation and ends EXIT=1; an independent focused run at 63600e23 read 6 passed and the run's own grouping file read 10 passed. Docked because after_suite.revision (26990870) is one docs-only commit below the reviewed head 63600e23, so after_suite.revision is not reviewed_head_sha, and because the base arm's tree carried the new test file that the base revision 7fbe5fd8 does not contain, so ten of its sixteen failure ids are the reproduction rather than a clean base arm.
justifications.fit: The change extends existing tables in place -- STATE_HUE gains a display alias beside its internal key, and _watch_verdict gains one branch in the module's classify-then-emit idiom -- with no plan label, version suffix or forbidden name. Docked because the display alias is placed into STATE_HUE, which the module unions into CLASSIFIER_STATE_WORDS, so the set documented as the producer/classifier vocabulary now carries a display form and the property test that binds it compares two STATE_HUE-derived sets.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both pieces of the declared goal land and are independently reproduced: removing the "lane event" hue key reddens test_every_state_the_snapshot_can_emit_has_a_colour with ('light', ['lane event']) exactly as at bbf96cca, and retargeting the emitted state word in _watch_verdict reddens test_the_blocked_bucket_is_derived_from_the_attention_set with 'lane-event' extra in the right set; head passes both. Docked one point because the group-to-emitter wiring this commit introduces is not itself asserted end to end (the only grouped-row fleet_verdict assertion checks recovery, not state), so the change is guarded only by the reducer's source-scraping property.
justifications.scope_discipline: The delta spans exactly the three declared files and the fragment was named by the done-when, so nothing outside the granted scope was touched and no shared index or plan state was mutated.
